title: Asymptotic Null Distributions of Moran's $I$ and Assortativity in Large Networks
summary: This study investigates the asymptotic behavior of two dependence measures defined on networks, Moran's $I$ statistic and Newman's assortativity, under the null hypothesis that a Gaussian node attribute $Y$ is independent of the network structure. We demonstrate that the structure of the network directly affects the convergence rate to normality of these measures as the size of the network increases.
